decimal_conversion: Decimal(str(Parquet value)); price complement computed as Decimal(1) - price; no epsilon tolerance.
method: Decimal aggregation by (tx_hash, condition_id, complementary token-price class); token A at p is paired with token B at 1-p, and same-token same-price rows share the same class.

per_tx_condition_conservation.method: Group all order_is_match_taker_order rows against maker rows by (tx_hash, condition_id); sum size_shares using Decimal(str(value)) and no tolerance. This includes same-token price levels and the condition's complementary token at 1-p within the transaction-condition total.

price_indexed_diagnostic.interpretation: Descriptive only: a taker order's price/size can aggregate multiple maker order price levels, so price-indexed buckets are not the transaction-condition conservation gate.
